position.name: Field Lab
position.sceneSentence: An ADHD person opens the app mid-thought needing to feel switched-on, not soothed; they want their whole mental field present and alive on screen, every type pulling its own weight, so nothing they are carrying quietly disappears.
position.oneParagraph: Field Lab is the bento board of your whole brain rebuilt as a charged, living instrument panel. Same everything-at-a-glance promise as before, but cool, sharp, and activated instead of warm and calm. The board is not a static list: tiles vary in size and glow-intensity by how full and how fresh each type is, so the surface looks different day to day and your brain re-engages instead of tuning it out. The whole field is organized into two charged neighborhoods — a STAKES zone (bills, due todos) and a PRESENT zone (ideas, somedays, events) — both lit, neither dimmed. Activation comes from charged presence, not pressure: every entry type glows in its own electric color at equal volume, so ideas and somedays are as alive as an overdue bill. Ideas and somedays that go untouched get a faint outline pulse — still here — the one place forgetting actually hurts. A companion voice reads the board like a status line: direct, stakes-aware, a little blunt. Nothing fades, nothing is hidden behind a filter, nothing rots in a grey corner.
position.feelInFirst3Seconds: Switched-on and oriented: my whole field is here, lit, and I can see at a glance what has stakes and what is just present, without anything shouting or anything fading.
position.wouldBeWrongToFeel: Soothed, sleepy, or that the app is a quiet warm place to relax. Also wrong: alarmed or stressed, as if only deadlines matter and everything else is noise.

references.lesson: Glow and intensity encode activity — a board that visibly reflects what is in it stays alive and readable, never a dead grid.
Cool, sharp, keyboard-first crispness; mono accents and disciplined restraint as the baseline an expressive layer sits on.
Data rendered as texture — size and color carry information so the layout itself is glanceable, not just labeled.
The old system read as warm/orange/soft/low-saturation — the derived vibe was the opposite of 'activating'. The brief is the gap: flip temperature, sharpen edges, charge the color.

rejectedDirections.name: Pulse (v1 D3)
rejectedDirections.whyRejected: Privileged time/countdowns, which makes anything without a deadline (ideas, somedays) second-class by design — the exact failure the user flagged: activation must not collapse into pressure.

rejectedDirections.name: Console (v2 D1)
rejectedDirections.whyRejected: Cockpit clarity was right but too restrained/efficient; the user wanted the board to feel more alive and expressive, with energy that changes day to day.

rejectedDirections.name: Voltage (v2 D2)
rejectedDirections.whyRejected: Loud uniform color-blocking risked the identical-card-grid slop and read as more launch-screen than living instrument; size/glow texture won over flat fill volume.

rejectedDirections.name: The Field (current shipped system)
rejectedDirections.whyRejected: Warm oat-cream/soot-brown, soft pastels, editorial calm — optimized for soothing, which the ADHD user experiences as sedating, not activating. Right structure (bento + capture bar), wrong temperature and energy.

tokens.name: color.dark.paper
tokens.why: Cool graphite, instrument-panel ground. Charged but breathable; never pure black (dead/harsh) and never warm (sedating).

tokens.name: color.light.paper
tokens.why: Cool crisp paper — light mode is also cool and sharp, never warm oat-cream. Keeps full parity.

tokens.name: color.dark.surface
tokens.why: One tonal step up from paper; tiles separate by tone + glow, not borders or shadow.

tokens.name: color.light.surface
tokens.why: Cool near-white tile, sits on cool paper. Color and glow live in the edge-bar, not the body.

tokens.name: color.dark.surfaceSubtle
tokens.why: Recessed seat for tiles; tonal-only sectioning.

tokens.name: color.light.surfaceSubtle
tokens.why: Cool recessed gutter for the light scheme.

tokens.name: color.dark.ink
tokens.why: Cool near-white; high contrast on graphite for the jolt/lock-in feel.

tokens.name: color.light.ink
tokens.why: Cool near-black, never pure black. Crisp on cool paper.

tokens.name: color.dark.inkMuted
tokens.why: Cool slate-grey for status lines, kickers, counts.

tokens.name: color.light.inkMuted
tokens.why: Cool grey-blue muted text for the light scheme.

tokens.name: color.type.deadline
tokens.why: Cool-biased coral. STAKES zone. Reads as consequence without being a warm red; the one type whose color also carries urgency.

tokens.name: color.type.todo
tokens.why: Electric cyan. Deliberately NOT green: green reads as done/completed and would lie on an open todo. Cyan = active, charged, cool.

tokens.name: color.type.idea
tokens.why: Cool-electric amber/gold. PRESENT zone. Glows for presence, not urgency — ideas pull the eye without alarming.

tokens.name: color.type.someday
tokens.why: Electric lime. PRESENT zone. Distinct from cyan-todo and amber-idea; alive, not warm.

tokens.name: color.type.event
tokens.why: Ultraviolet. The remaining cool slot; distinct from all four others, completes the five-type charged set.

tokens.name: color.typeKicker.deadline
tokens.why: Darker coral for 11px all-caps labels to clear WCAG AA on the dark/light tile.

tokens.name: color.typeKicker.todo
tokens.why: Darker cyan for AA-legible kicker text.

tokens.name: color.typeKicker.idea
tokens.why: Darker amber for AA on tint.

tokens.name: color.typeKicker.someday
tokens.why: Darker lime for AA on tint.

tokens.name: color.typeKicker.event
tokens.why: Darker violet for AA on tint.

tokens.name: color.tint.deadline.dark
tokens.why: Charged dark coral wash; glow-intensity scales on top by content density.

tokens.name: color.tint.deadline.light
tokens.why: Cool coral tint for light scheme.

tokens.name: color.tint.todo.dark
tokens.why: Charged dark cyan wash.

tokens.name: color.tint.todo.light
tokens.why: Cool cyan tint for light.

tokens.name: color.tint.idea.dark
tokens.why: Charged dark amber wash.

tokens.name: color.tint.idea.light
tokens.why: Cool amber tint for light.

tokens.name: color.tint.someday.dark
tokens.why: Charged dark lime wash.

tokens.name: color.tint.someday.light
tokens.why: Cool lime tint for light.

tokens.name: color.tint.event.dark
tokens.why: Charged dark violet wash.

tokens.name: color.tint.event.light
tokens.why: Cool violet tint for light.

tokens.name: accent.signal
tokens.role: The one action color — capture bar active, primary actions
tokens.why: Electric cyan shared with todo as the universal 'go/active' charge. Replaces clay terracotta.

tokens.name: accent.signalPressed
tokens.why: Deeper cyan for press state.

tokens.name: feedback.success
tokens.why: Cool emerald — completion is the ONLY place green is allowed, precisely because green means done. Reinforces that todo (cyan) is not done.

tokens.name: feedback.warning
tokens.why: Reuses amber; cool-charged caution.

tokens.name: feedback.danger
tokens.why: Hot cool-red, the stakes signal at full intensity.

tokens.name: color.glow.faint
tokens.why: Field Lab signature: edge-bar/tile glow opacity scales with content density + freshness. Faint = sparse/quiet tile.

tokens.name: color.glow.strong
tokens.why: Full, fresh tiles glow brighter — the board visibly reflects what is in it. (Hue is per-type at runtime; cyan shown as base.)

tokens.name: color.glow.stalePulse
tokens.why: Faint outline pulse on untouched ideas/somedays (7d+) — 'still here'. Only on no-deadline types where forgetting hurts; kept rare to stay noticed.

family.value: Inter (UI/body/display) + SF Mono / JetBrains Mono (counts, kickers, status line)
family.why: Drops Fraunces entirely — serif is warm/editorial, the opposite of activating. Inter is cool, sharp, dense; a mono carries counts and the companion status line for an instrument-panel signal. Hierarchy = size + weight + sans/mono contrast, not serif-vs-sans.

type.why: Activation reads through sharp weight jumps and the mono signal layer; no serif warmth anywhere.

spacing.why: Keep the established 4pt base (fixes the 44%-fit drift the forensics flagged). Generous between zones, tighter inside tiles; Field Lab varies tile footprint by content, so the grid gutter rhythm must stay strict to keep the responsive board legible.

radius.why: Sharper than The Field's large-soft radii — crisp instrument-panel edges read as charged/surgical. Slightly above pure-sharp so resizing tiles still read as movable cards on a map, not hard chips.

motion.why: Tiles re-flow and resize with a quick spring (damping 18, stiffness 220) when content changes — the living board. The stale-pulse on untouched ideas/somedays is the ONE sanctioned continuous motion (slow, faint outline); it is the content, not decoration. Reduced-motion: resizing becomes instant, stale-pulse becomes a static outline ring.

scale.name: tile
scale.value: cool shadow rgba(20,30,45,0.40), y6, blur18 / android elevation 2; fuller tiles lift slightly more
scale.why: Depth encodes content density — a packed tile sits higher. No warm or pure-black shadow.

scale.name: capture
scale.value: cool shadow rgba(20,30,45,0.50), y-2, blur16 / android elevation 8
scale.why: Always-on capture bar floats above the board.

elevation.why: Layered, cool-tinted depth gives the bento its living-map quality without borders; elevation carries information (fuller = higher), not just decoration.

ruledOut: No warm tones anywhere — no oat-cream, no soot-brown-warm, no orange/terracotta. Cool only.
No serif (Fraunces removed) — Inter + mono only.
No pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) — cool extremes only.
No FAB — capture stays an always-on bottom bar.
No 1px structural borders — tonal layering, edge-bars, and glow carry structure.
No dimming or fading non-urgent types — ideas/somedays glow at equal volume; activation is presence, not pressure.
No urgency-only signaling — the board must not collapse into 'only deadlines matter'.
No uniform identical-card grid — tile size/glow varies by content (bounded), but every type keeps a visible minimum slot so nothing drops off.
No dead count-only tiles — every tile shows real, tappable items.
No 'today' curation or filters that hide things — whole field always present.
No streaks, badges, confetti, gamification, or celebration.
No gradients (no LinearGradient buttons/glows) — glow is solid-color opacity, not a gradient ramp.
Green is reserved for completion only (feedback.success) — never a type color, so todo (cyan) never reads as done.
Stale-pulse only on untouched ideas/somedays (7d+), kept rare so it stays noticed.
Rotation/AI resurfacing is OUT of this rebrand — parked for MVP 2.

darkMode.strategy: Full light + dark parity, both cool and sharp. Per-scheme paper/surface/ink and per-scheme type-tints; type codes shared across schemes. Resolved through the existing useTheme() / ThemeProvider System-Light-Dark preference.

migrationHints.phaseHints: The structural shell (bento board, always-on capture bar, useTheme()/ThemeProvider, entryColor/useSurfaceColor accessors, FieldTile/CaptureBar/FieldGreeting components) already exists from the prior migration and is KEPT. This rebrand is primarily a token-value swap (color temperature flip, type family Inter+mono replacing Fraunces+Inter, sharper radii) PLUS three net-new behaviors on the existing components: (1) bounded tile resizing by content density with a per-type visible minimum, (2) per-type glow opacity scaling with density+freshness, (3) stale-pulse outline on untouched ideas/somedays. Phase 1: swap color/type/radius/motion/elevation token values. Phase 2: remove Fraunces from expo-font loading, wire mono font. Phase 3: implement glow + bounded-resize on FieldTile. Phase 4: implement stale-pulse (idea/someday only) respecting useReducedMotion(). Phase 5: re-verify WCAG AA on all kicker-on-tint pairs in both schemes. The 200 hardcoded values from forensics should be tokenized in the same pass or they will not respond to the new system.
